prompt.alinti: Someone built a Claude code agent whose only job is to get you customers. It's called Harvey and it's open source and free. Tell it what you sell and who your ideal customer is and Harvey finds leads, researches them, and identifies the best fits. Then Claude turns that research into personalized cold emails. It can also track replies, manage your sales pipeline, and work toward booking meetings, all running 24-7 on your computer. It even uses your existing Claude subscription and comes with a live dashboard for your entire pipeline.
